name: Utsugi Kyoshi
source:
A picture-perfect, kind husband. He works for a major trading company. he is indifferent to sex.

He is good at his job and has recently become more and more fulfilled as he competes for promotion within the company. 

[From [url=https://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai/ubai_chara.html]official site[/url]]
